scope: Random initialization, CPU eval(), seed=20261021; structural checks only, not accuracy evidence.

batch_dependence.interpretation: Batch composition matters; permutation of the same batch preserves predictions.

cross_node_observation_path.perturbation: Add 100 only to historical flow at node 1; keep calendars and target node 0 unchanged.
cross_node_observation_path.interpretation: Current operations transmit no other-node current observations to a target node. Static learned graph identity remains present.

broadcast_time_axis.interpretation: Internal time slices are copies. Forecast horizons still use distinct regression output channels. Training dropout has independent masks; this check establishes eval equivalence only.

temporal_router_spatial_identity.interpretation: The temporal router lacks explicit node/graph/spatial-prototype inputs. Own-node history can still carry spatial information, and the downstream MLP can learn joint effects.

conditional_relation_algebra.interpretation: A zero C preserves the current router. Identical C rows are an existing temporal-logit bias; rowwise constants cancel in softmax. Double centering removes both redundancies.
conditional_relation_algebra.fair_controls: Keep backbone and both query projections identical for Q-only, Q+S, Q+T, Q+S+T, and Q+S+T+C. Also compare concat or a matched-budget identity-conditioned allocator: improvements from extra parameters or identity input alone do not establish a unique benefit of prototype relations.
